question.title: TOWN OF ELON MIXED BEVERAGE ELECTION

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (71) for the class 'local measure, NC'

threshold.rule: G.S. 18B-602(h) sets only the ballot words for a mixed beverage election; the result rule is not in that subsection. G.S. 18B-601(a) runs an alcoholic beverage election 'in the same manner and under the same rules as a referendum under Chapter 163'; G.S. 18B-604(b) speaks of 'a majority of voters' voting in favor of alcoholic beverage sales; G.S. 163-182.15(d) says that in a referendum the proposal with the highest number of votes prevails.
